name: Azure Maps
tagline: Microsoft cloud geospatial platform for maps, search, routing, and location services
description: Azure Maps provides REST APIs for interactive maps, geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing, traffic, weather, and spatial analytics. Developers authenticate with a subscription key or Microsoft Entra ID and call atlas.microsoft.com endpoints for location-aware applications.

auth.details: Subscription key via subscription-key query param or subscription-key header; also Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) OAuth2 bearer tokens for managed identity/app registration

pricing.free_tier_limits: Gen2 free monthly allotments by service (e.g. 5,000 Render Tile transactions; other services have separate free quantities — see Azure Maps pricing).

rate_limits: Per-service QPS limits published (e.g. Search ~500 QPS, Routing ~50 QPS, Render ~500 QPS; see Azure Maps QPS rate limits).
use_cases: reverse geocode lat/lon to an address
get driving directions between two points
display map tiles in a web or mobile app
